fields.title: Find the Excess
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Where to look first if the bill grew by 25% without audience growth?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: order — idle resources (forgotten environments, replicas after migrations); storage accumulation without retention; new analytics events added by the team; inter-zone traffic after migrations; billing model change or expiration of reservations. Verified in a day if resource tagging is in place. Without tagging, the first step is to introduce it, otherwise analysis is impossible.
